2\. Decided jobs receive late hold notices 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
Api.send and _publish_held await held-reason computation, then announce a hold without
rechecking the job’s gate or current state. If another client approves or denies the job during that
wait, the later notification describes a hold that no longer exists and can create new approval
buttons.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description A client can approve or deny a held job while `Api.send` or startup hold publication awaits reason computation, leaving a stale hold event or notification to be published. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/api.py[440-451] - src/hands/daemon.py[424-428] - src/hands/daemon.py[430-451] - src/hands/daemon.py[901-912] ## Recommended Fix After reason computation, reload the job before filing `job.held` or publishing a startup hold. File the event only if the gate is still pending, and publish the startup hold only if the job is still held; keep the startup list consistent with that check and clear any cached reason when the gate has already been decided. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
